MITHE TERE BOL PARI (Official Video) Masoom Sharma | Aman Jaji & Pranjal Dahiya | Mukesh Jaji | Kuldeep Rathee | New Haryanvi Songs Haryanavi 2026
Folk Station Haryanvi presents 'MITHE TERE BOL PARI' new haryanvi song 2026 sung by Masoom Sharma. Song is written my Mukesh Jaji. featuring Mr Aman Jaji Pranjal Dahiya. Video is shot by KULDEEP RATHEE.
Song - Mithe Tere Bol Pari
Singer - Masoom Sharma
Starring - Aman Jaji & Pranjal Dahiya
Lyrics - Respected Mukesh Jaji
Music/composer - Aman Jaji
Director - Kuldeep Rathee
